# THRUSTLINGS audio

Two NASA recordings are included locally; the runtime uses short crossfaded sections at
low volume with low-pass/band-pass filters, soft attack/release and a master compressor.

- `nasa-sls-test-fire.mp3`: **SLS Test Fire**, NASA Historical Sounds.
  https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/663784main_SLS_Audio_D.mp3
- `nasa-discovery-launch.mp3`: **Discovery STS-131: Sound of Launch**, NASA Historical Sounds.
  https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/590189main_ringtone_131_launchNats.mp3

Source collection: https://www.nasa.gov/historical-sounds/
Usage policy: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/
NASA states that its content, including audio, generally is not subject to copyright
in the United States. No NASA insignia or endorsement is used. Recordings remain
credited to NASA; this game is independent of NASA. Downloaded 2026-10-22.

The quieter high-frequency thruster layer is a game sound-design adaptation of the
launch recording, not a recording of a spacecraft RCS jet. The victory tones and crash
noise are generated in the browser. Sound is off until the user enables it.
